evals.prompt: Initialize DOX in this Git repository, show me exactly what will be created, and do not write anything until I approve it.
evals.expected_output: A deterministic dry-run proposal and an explicit --apply boundary.

evals.prompt: I am changing src/auth/login.ts. Find the relevant decision and any invariant that enforces authorization there, including the verification command.
evals.expected_output: A path resolution with a receipt and a full invariant binding.

evals.prompt: Lint our DOX records before the release and report broken ownership, ADR references, and documentation links.
evals.expected_output: Lint diagnostics with errors distinguished from warnings.

evals.prompt: Read-only: explain how authentication works in this DOX-enabled repository and identify the governing decisions and invariants. Do not edit anything.
evals.expected_output: DOX is queried before broad source inspection; record retrieval stays inside one task-oriented CLI resolution; the compact receipt exposes applicable owners, decisions, contracts, complete invariant bindings, dependencies, and deferred IDs; full bodies are expanded only by discovered ID when needed; the answer does not enumerate the record directory or perform overlapping synonym calls.
